Bulk update object specifications to use base trait groups and manage field
lifecycle.



This command helps maintain consistency across object specs by:

- Replacing explicit trait lists with base trait groups (base_object_traits,
base_auditable_traits)

- Managing field lifecycle (define a new field; aliases add/create, then modify,
deprecate, archive, delete)

- Tracking field versioning and breaking changes

- Validating changes before applying

- Refreshing docs/process/_internal/spec_index.json after successful writes
(same path as generate-spec-index)

  Preview what would be updated (dry-run)
  zqk.test system update-specs --dry-run
  Update all specs that extend base_object to use base_object_traits
  zqk.test system update-specs --trait-groups
  Update specific spec files
  zqk.test system update-specs --files backlog_item.yaml,goal.yaml
  Define a new field (add and create are synonyms)
  zqk.test system update-specs backlog_item --field new_field --operation define --reason "Adding new field for feature X"
  Field operation then run REQ-019 field-vetting on the written spec
  zqk.test system update-specs goal --field priority --operation define --validate --reason "…"

Usage:
  zqk.test system update-specs [flags]

Flags:
      --breaking-change          Mark change as breaking
      --dry-run                  Preview changes without applying them
      --field string             Field name to operate on (for field operations)
      --files stringArray        Specific spec files to update (comma-separated)
      --migration-notes string   Migration guidance for breaking changes
      --operation string         Field operation: define (new field; aliases add, create), modify, deprecate, archive, delete
      --reason string            Reason for the change
      --replaced-by string       Field that replaces this one (for deprecate/delete)
      --trait-groups             Update specs to use base trait groups
      --validate                 Validate specs after updating (trait/file batch) or after a field operation (same REQ-019 path as check --validate-specs)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
